description.value: The Waypoint Restaurant and Bar occupies a prime lakefront position within the historic Kaslo Hotel on the shores of Kootenay Lake, offering a seasonally evolving, regionally inspired menu alongside craft cocktails, an espresso bar, and a curated selection of BC wines and craft beers. A spacious patio with sweeping lake views draws locals and travellers alike, and the hotel's own adventure pages explicitly direct mountain bikers from Kaslo's trail network back to The Waypoint for a post-ride drink. The hotel holding a 'Green' certification with BC Green Business adds a sustainability dimension appealing to conscious travellers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at kaslohotel.com/food-drink/ provides rich primary evidence: The Waypoint is an active, full-service lakefront restaurant and bar inside the Kaslo Hotel at 430 Front Street, with current live-music events confirming it is open as of the date of enrichment. OSM tags confirm outdoor_seating=yes and toilets=yes; the hotel facilities subpage explicitly lists 'Free WiFi' as a hotel amenity that logically extends to the restaurant. No bike rack, bike parking, takeout, or water-refill evidence appears anywhere on the site, though the Things to Do page directly invites mountain bikers to return to The Waypoint patio after riding local trails.
concerns: OSM name is 'Waypoint Restaurant and Bar' but website consistently uses 'The Waypoint Restaurant and Bar' — minor article discrepancy, OSM value retained per rules.
OSM record carries no address or phone; both values sourced from website contact page only, so contact_confirmed fields are null for those.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible lakefront restaurant and bar in an established hotel; website confirms current operations and events.

wow_evidence: hotel's own adventure pages explicitly direct mountain bikers from Kaslo's trail network back to The Waypoint for a post-ride drink
